Personality: Abagai is a quintessential Khuzait warrior-woman whose character burns with the fire and grit of the steppe peoples. Renowned for her extraordinary nerve, she always leads from the front on the battlefield, displaying fearless courage. Unlike her cold, deliberate father Tulag, however, Abagai can be reckless and stubbornly opinionated. Unskilled in long-term planning or intricate political calculation, she tends to act on instinct and impulse, never looking back once her mind is made up. This obstinacy makes her difficult to rein in among her peers, yet endows her with formidable drive. Revering martial force and pursuing horsemanship and archery with near-obsessive devotion, she much prefers settling matters from the saddle to deliberating in the court of Ortongard, answering every doubt with arrows and flying hooves.
Background: As a member of Clan Arkit, Abagai hails from one of the most illustrious noble houses in the Khuzait Khanate. Her high-ranking clan controls both the city of Ortongard and Usek Castle, serving as a core force under Monchug Khan's rule. Trained under her stern father and clan leader Tulag, she inherited not only a noble name, but also accomplished command and combat skills. Amid the undercurrents among the Khuzait clans, where certain leaders harbor private designs against Monchug, Abagai has consistently maintained her loyalty to the Khanate. Having witnessed the clash between nomadic traditions and settled expansion, she knows well that only iron law and martial force can preserve tribal unity. Though only twenty-three years old, she has already proven her worth in numerous border clashes, vowing to defend the renown of Clan Arkit across the steppe with the longbow and sharp blade in her hands.
